snippet.title: SANSKRITI IAS
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Sanskriti IAS!
The objective of Sanskriti IAS is to provide comprehensive & quality coaching for aspiring candidates preparing for the Civil Services Examination conducted by UPSC. 

Sanskriti IAS Institute provide a conducive learning environment, expert faculty, updated study materials, and regular assessment practices. 

'Sanskriti IAS’ was founded on the 3rd of January 2020. Presently, Sanskriti IAS is situated within two locations Mukherjee Nagar(Delhi) and Prayagraj(Uttar Pradesh). If you require any assistance from Sanskriti IAS, you may reach us via +91 95551 24124 or +91 7428085757 OR visit our website www.sanskritiias.com.

snippet.title: My Inspired Home
snippet.description:

Whether it’s creating easy meal plans, cozy aesthetics, or storage solutions, I'm here to chat about it all!

Sharing all the tips, twists and tricks I have learned over the years!

Welcome to My Inspired Home! 🤗

snippet.title: Rhett Callahan Prepping
snippet.description:
I’m Rhett Callahan, and this channel is your no-nonsense guide to practical prepping, tactical readiness, and real-world survival. I don't deal in fear-mongering or far-fetched theories—just actionable, field-tested strategies designed to keep you and your family secure when the unexpected hits.

My team and I work hard to break down everything from long-term food security and grid-down power solutions to advanced bushcraft, home defense, and austere medical response. Whether you’re a seasoned prepper refining a complex bug-out plan or a beginner looking to build your very first emergency kit, we build and test these systems by hand so you can navigate any crisis with confidence.

snippet.title: Dan Becker Podcast
snippet.description: One moment you're living life normally — the next, you're fighting to stay alive. This podcast shares real conversations with people who faced the unimaginable: animal attacks, natural disasters, remote wilderness injuries, and situations with no guarantee of rescue. snippet.title: Dreamverse
snippet.description:
Dreamverse is a channel of long-form Marvel investigations. Each video takes one question about the MCU, lays out the evidence from the films, shows and comics, and ends with my own verdict.

I'm Yaroslav, and I make these videos myself. For each one I pick the question, collect what fans are arguing about, check every claim against the source, and build the argument. I separate what is confirmed on screen from leaks and from my own theories, and I say which is which.

How the videos are made: the script comes from my own research and outline, and I use AI tools to help draft and edit it. The narration is a synthesized voice. I cut the footage to match the argument scene by scene.

Think I got something wrong? Tell me in the comments. Good catches make it into later videos.

Not affiliated with Marvel or Disney. Film footage is used for commentary and analysis.
